newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB launches A$250m Southcorp notes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB launches A$250m Southcorp notes.

text.p: National Australia Bank said on Thursday it launched a A$250 million medium term note programme for diversified manufacturer Southcorp Holdings Ltd.
NAB said it subscribed for an initial A$100 million and onsold these securities to a range of banks and financial institutions.
NAB general manager, global project and structured finance, Ian Mattiske, said it was the first term issue of securities in the domestic market by an Australian corporate since the late 1980s.
Demand was strong, with subscriptions scaled back to meet reequests from all investors, he said in a statement.
The floating rate notes are priced at 50 points over the 90-day bank bill swap rate and mature on 15 December, 2006.

A dealer panel has been established for the remaining A$150 million of the programme, comprising Bankers Trust Australia Ltd, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Australia Ltd, National Australia Bank and Westpac Banking Corp.
